title: Indian Air Force Airmen Group Y Medical Assistant Intake 02/2027 Admit Card 2026
postName: Airmen Group Y Medical Assistant Intake 02/2027
qualification: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with minimum 50% aggregate and 50% in English, or a 2-year vocational course with the required subjects and marks. Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy candidates require minimum 50% aggregate and valid State Pharmacy Council or Pharmacy Council of India registration.
ageLimit: For 10+2 candidates: upper age limit 21 years. For Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy candidates: upper age limit 24 years. Age and marital-status conditions apply as per the official notification.
applicationFee: INR 550 for General / OBC / EWS and SC / ST / PH candidates. Pay online through debit card, credit card, net banking or other available modes.
selectionProcess: Proficiency Test -> English Written Test -> Physical Fitness Test I and II -> Adaptability Test II -> Medical Examination
documentsRequired: Downloaded admit card, valid original photo ID, educational and pharmacy registration documents where applicable.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official Indian Air Force Airmen portal
2. Open Intake 02/2027 candidate login
3. Login with registered credentials
4. Download the exam-city details or admit card
5. Verify the centre, reporting time and instructions
shortDescription: Indian Air Force has released the Airmen Group Y Medical Assistant Intake 02/2027 exam-city and admit-card update. Enrolled candidates can download the admit card from the official portal.
content:
Indian Air Force (IAF) has released the Airmen Group Y Medical Assistant Intake 02/2027 Admit Card 2026 update.

The examination is scheduled for 22 and 23 September 2026. Candidates should download the exam-city details and admit card from the official portal.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 06/07/2026
  • Last date to apply: 26/07/2026
  • Exam city available: 11/09/2026
  • Exam date: 22-23/09/2026
  • Admit card available: 19/09/2026

Eligibility overview

  • 10+2 route: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with the required marks.
  • Pharmacy route: Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy with the required marks and valid registration.
